ex.en: I am working to save for my college tuition.
ex.zh: 我打工是為了存大學學費。

ex.en: Today is the last day to pay tuition fees, and my credit card has no money on it.
ex.zh: 今天是繳學費的最後一天，可是我的卡裡沒錢了。

tuition.en: money paid for being taught, especially at a college

ex.en: She gives private tuition in math.
ex.zh: 她私下教數學家教。

ex.en: The school offers extra tuition for weaker students.
ex.zh: 學校為程度較弱的學生提供額外輔導。

tuition.en: the teaching of a subject, especially to one person or a small group

ex.en: This tunnel is twice as long as that one.
ex.zh: 這條隧道是那條的兩倍長。

ex.en: The sightseeing bus ran through a long tunnel.
ex.zh: 觀光巴士穿過了一條長長的隧道。

ex.en: Where is the longest tunnel in Japan?
ex.zh: 日本最長的隧道在哪裡？

tunnel.en: a long passage built under the ground or through a hill

ex.en: The workers tunneled through the mountain.
ex.zh: 工人們挖隧道穿過那座山。

ex.en: They tunneled under the river to build the subway.
ex.zh: 他們在河底挖隧道來建捷運。

tunnel.en: to dig a long passage under the ground or through a hill

ex.en: Japanese people like to eat tuna.
ex.zh: 日本人喜歡吃鮪魚。

ex.en: The skin of a shark is much rougher than that of a tuna fish.
ex.zh: 鯊魚的皮比鮪魚粗糙得多。

ex.en: I'll have a tuna sandwich, please.
ex.zh: 我要一份鮪魚三明治。

tuna.en: a large sea fish eaten as food

ex.en: A tuple in Python cannot be changed after it is created.
ex.zh: Python 的元組建立之後就不能修改。

ex.en: The function returns a tuple of two values.
ex.zh: 這個函式會回傳一個含兩個值的元組。

tuple.en: an ordered list of values in programming that cannot be changed

ex.en: The price of rice has tumbled.
ex.zh: 米價大跌了。

ex.en: Stock prices tumbled after the announcement.
ex.zh: 消息公布後股價暴跌。

tumble.en: to fall very quickly in amount or value

ex.en: She tumbled down the stairs.
ex.zh: 她從樓梯上摔了下來。

ex.en: The boxes tumbled off the truck.
ex.zh: 箱子從卡車上滾落下來。

tumble.en: to fall suddenly and roll or bounce

ex.en: The stock market is in turmoil.
ex.zh: 股市一片混亂。

ex.en: The company was in turmoil after the CEO resigned.
ex.zh: 執行長辭職後，公司陷入一片混亂。

turmoil.en: a state of great confusion and trouble

ex.en: She played a tune on the piano.
ex.zh: 她用鋼琴彈了一首曲子。

ex.en: She shall never forget listening to the sad tune.
ex.zh: 她永遠不會忘記聽到那首悲傷曲子的情景。

tune.en: a pleasant series of musical notes that you can sing or play

ex.en: This piano has probably not been tuned for years.
ex.zh: 這台鋼琴可能好幾年沒調音了。

ex.en: Tom went to school to learn how to tune pianos.
ex.zh: 湯姆去學校學怎麼幫鋼琴調音。

tune.en: to adjust a musical instrument so it plays the right notes, or to adjust an engine or machine

tune.zh: stay tuned：敬請鎖定、持續關注

ex.en: Stay tuned for more updates.
ex.zh: 請持續關注更多最新消息。

ex.en: Stay tuned, we'll be right back after the break.
ex.zh: 別走開，廣告後馬上回來。

tune.en: used to ask people to keep watching or listening for more news

tube.zh: 管子；（牙膏等的）一條、一管

ex.en: Please buy a tube of toothpaste.
ex.zh: 請買一條牙膏。

ex.en: You can't put toothpaste back in the tube.
ex.zh: 牙膏擠出來就塞不回去了。

tube.en: a long hollow pipe, or a soft container for thick liquids that you squeeze

ex.en: Where's the nearest tube station?
ex.zh: 最近的地鐵站在哪裡？

ex.en: Londoners call the subway "The Tube."
ex.zh: 倫敦人把地鐵叫做「The Tube」。

tube.en: the underground train system in London

ex.en: I got a stomach tumor and had to have it operated on.
ex.zh: 我得了胃腫瘤，必須開刀切除。

ex.en: I have a brain tumor.
ex.zh: 我有腦瘤。

ex.en: The doctors found that the tumor was not cancerous.
ex.zh: 醫生發現那顆腫瘤不是惡性的。

tumor.en: a lump in the body caused by cells growing in an uncontrolled way

ex.en: The company went through a turbulent period last year.
ex.zh: 這家公司去年經歷了一段動盪時期。

ex.en: Prices have been rising in these turbulent times.
ex.zh: 在這動盪的時期，物價持續上漲。

turbulent.en: full of sudden change, trouble and confusion

ex.en: The flight was turbulent, so we kept our seat belts on.
ex.zh: 飛行途中氣流不穩，所以我們一直繫著安全帶。

ex.en: The boat struggled through the turbulent waters.
ex.zh: 小船在洶湧的海水中艱難前進。

turbulent.en: moving in a rough and uneven way

tutor.zh: 家教、家庭教師；（大學）助教、導師

ex.en: He is a tutor for the math department.
ex.zh: 他是數學系的助教。

ex.en: My parents hired a tutor to help me with English.
ex.zh: 我爸媽請了家教幫我加強英文。

ex.en: Amy works as a private tutor on weekends.
ex.zh: Amy 週末兼差當家教。

tutor.en: a person who teaches one student or a small group, or a teacher at a university

ex.en: She tutors high school students in math.
ex.zh: 她當家教，教高中生數學。

ex.en: Tom was tutored at home for a year.
ex.zh: Tom 在家接受了一年的家教指導。

tutor.en: to teach one student or a small group

ex.en: Juan died from tuberculosis.
ex.zh: 胡安死於肺結核。

ex.en: Tuberculosis is a serious disease that mainly attacks the lungs.
ex.zh: 結核病是一種主要侵襲肺部的嚴重疾病。

ex.en: Everyone in the class had a test for tuberculosis.
ex.zh: 班上每個人都做了肺結核檢查。

tuberculosis.en: a serious infectious disease that mainly affects the lungs

ex.en: Voter turnout was over 70% this year.
ex.zh: 今年的投票率超過七成。

ex.en: There was a good turnout for the event.
ex.zh: 這場活動來了不少人。

turnout.en: the number of people who come to an event or vote in an election

ex.en: High staff turnover is costly for any business.
ex.zh: 員工流動率高對任何企業都是很大的成本。

ex.en: We need to reduce turnover in the call center.
ex.zh: 我們需要降低客服中心的人員流動率。

turnover.en: the rate at which workers leave a company and are replaced

ex.en: This company achieved a remarkable increase in turnover last year.
ex.zh: 這家公司去年的營業額大幅成長。

ex.en: The shop has an annual turnover of two million dollars.
ex.zh: 這家店一年的營業額是兩百萬元。

turnover.en: the total amount of money a business earns in a period

ex.en: After two difficult years, the retailer’s turnaround began with a smaller product range.
ex.zh: 經歷兩年困境後，這家零售商從縮減產品種類開始扭轉局面。

ex.en: The repair center promises a three-day turnaround for standard service calls.
ex.zh: 維修中心承諾一般服務案件可在三天內處理完畢。

turnaround.en: a big change for the better, or the time needed to finish a piece of work

ex.en: Your ticket will unlock the turnstile at the station entrance.
ex.zh: 車票可開啟車站入口的驗票閘門。

ex.en: A broken turnstile caused a long line during rush hour.
ex.zh: 一座旋轉柵門故障，導致尖峰時段大排長龍。

turnstile.en: a gate with metal arms that turn to let one person pass at a time

ex.en: Please return to your seat. We are experiencing some turbulence.
ex.zh: 請回到座位上，我們正遇到一些亂流。

ex.en: The turbulence made my coffee spill.
ex.zh: 亂流讓我的咖啡灑了出來。

turbulence.en: rough and sudden movements of air that shake a plane

ex.en: The company went through a period of financial turbulence.
ex.zh: 這家公司經歷了一段財務動盪期。

ex.en: Markets are still recovering from last year's turbulence.
ex.zh: 市場仍在從去年的動盪中恢復。

turbulence.en: a situation of trouble and sudden change

ex.en: Turn left at the second traffic light.
ex.zh: 在第二個紅綠燈左轉。

ex.en: The car turned into a narrow street.
ex.zh: 車子轉進一條窄巷。

turn.en: to change direction or move around to face a different way

ex.en: These green leaves turn red or yellow in fall.
ex.zh: 這些綠葉到秋天變成紅色或黃色。

ex.en: The weather turned cold overnight.
ex.zh: 天氣一夜之間變冷了。

ex.en: Do you mind if I turn off the light?
ex.zh: 你介意我把燈關掉嗎？

ex.en: He turned off the TV and began to study.
ex.zh: 他關掉了電視開始學習。

turn.en: to stop a machine or light from working by using a switch

ex.en: It's your turn to wash the dishes.
ex.zh: 輪到你洗碗了。

ex.en: Please wait your turn.
ex.zh: 請等輪到你。

turn.en: the chance to do something that people do one after another

ex.en: We had roast turkey for dinner on Thanksgiving.
ex.zh: 感恩節晚餐我們吃了烤火雞。

ex.en: A wild turkey walked across the road in front of us.
ex.zh: 一隻野生火雞走過我們前方的馬路。

ex.en: I ordered a turkey sandwich for lunch.
ex.zh: 我午餐點了一份火雞肉三明治。

ex.en: Turkey is lower in fat than many other meats.
ex.zh: 火雞肉的脂肪比許多其他肉類低。

ex.en: She tucked her shirt into her pants.
ex.zh: 她把襯衫塞進褲子裡。

ex.en: He tucked the letter into his pocket.
ex.zh: 他把信塞進口袋。

ex.en: Mom tucked the blanket around the baby.
ex.zh: 媽媽把毯子掖在嬰兒身邊。

ex.en: The dress has a small tuck at the waist.
ex.zh: 這件洋裝腰部有個小褶。

ex.en: The tailor made a tuck in the sleeve.
ex.zh: 裁縫師在袖子上做了一個褶。

ex.en: The doctor said the tumour was small and not dangerous.
ex.zh: 醫生說這個腫瘤很小，並不危險。

ex.en: He had surgery to remove a tumour from his stomach.
ex.zh: 他動手術切除了胃裡的一個腫瘤。

ex.en: We have a team meeting every Tuesday morning.
ex.zh: 我們每星期二早上都有團隊會議。

ex.en: The library is closed on Tuesday because of cleaning.
ex.zh: 圖書館星期二因為打掃而休館。

ex.en: Let's meet on Tuesday after class.
ex.zh: 我們星期二下課後見面吧。

ex.en: We had Turkish tea at a small cafe.
ex.zh: 我們在一家小咖啡館喝了土耳其茶。

ex.en: She bought a beautiful Turkish carpet at the market.
ex.zh: 她在市場買了一條漂亮的土耳其地毯。

ex.en: He speaks Turkish and English at home.
ex.zh: 他在家裡說土耳其語和英語。

ex.en: Turkish is the official language of Turkey.
ex.zh: 土耳其語是土耳其的官方語言。

ex.en: The turner shaped the metal part on his lathe.
ex.zh: 車工用車床把金屬零件加工成形。

ex.en: A skilled turner can make a perfect wooden bowl.
ex.zh: 熟練的車工能做出完美的木碗。

ex.en: She likes to relax in a hot tub after work.
ex.zh: 她下班後喜歡泡在熱水浴缸裡放鬆。

ex.en: The baby splashed happily in the tub.
ex.zh: 嬰兒在浴缸裡開心地潑水。

ex.en: We finished a whole tub of ice cream in one night.
ex.zh: 我們一個晚上就吃完了一整桶冰淇淋。

ex.en: He bought a tub of butter at the supermarket.
ex.zh: 他在超市買了一盒奶油。

ex.en: The child tugged at his mother's sleeve.
ex.zh: 孩子用力拉扯媽媽的袖子。

ex.en: She tugged the heavy bag across the floor.
ex.zh: 她把沉重的袋子在地板上拖著走。

ex.en: He tugged the rope until the boat came closer.
ex.zh: 他用力拉繩子，直到船靠近。

ex.en: I felt a tug on my fishing line.
ex.zh: 我感覺釣線被用力扯了一下。

ex.en: Give the door a hard tug if it sticks.
ex.zh: 如果門卡住了，就用力拉一下。

ex.en: Take the second turning on the left.
ex.zh: 在第二個路口左轉。

ex.en: We missed the turning and had to drive back.
ex.zh: 我們錯過了那個岔路口，只好開回去。

ex.en: There is a turning just after the petrol station.
ex.zh: 加油站後面不遠有一個岔路口。

turning.zh: 轉動；轉向；變成（turn 的現在分詞）

ex.en: She is turning the page of her book.
ex.zh: 她正在翻書頁。

ex.en: The leaves are turning red and yellow in autumn.
ex.zh: 秋天時樹葉正轉成紅色和黃色。

ex.en: He kept turning his head to look at the clock.
ex.zh: 他不停轉頭去看時鐘。

ex.en: The turtle moved slowly across the road.
ex.zh: 那隻烏龜慢慢地爬過馬路。

ex.en: Sea turtles lay their eggs on sandy beaches.
ex.zh: 海龜在沙灘上產卵。

ex.en: The players slipped on the wet turf.
ex.zh: 球員們在溼滑的草皮上滑倒了。

ex.en: The stadium replaced its old turf this summer.
ex.zh: 這座體育場今年夏天換掉了舊草皮。

ex.en: Don't walk into their turf without asking.
ex.zh: 沒問過就別闖進他們的地盤。

ex.en: The two companies are fighting over turf in the market.
ex.zh: 這兩家公司正在市場上爭奪地盤。

ex.en: The wind turbine turns slowly in the breeze.
ex.zh: 風力渦輪機在微風中緩緩轉動。

ex.en: Steam turbines are used to produce electricity in many power plants.
ex.zh: 許多發電廠使用蒸汽渦輪機來發電。

ex.en: They live in an old Tudor house with dark wooden beams.
ex.zh: 他們住在一間有深色木樑的都鐸式老房子。

ex.en: We visited a Tudor castle on our trip to England.
ex.zh: 我們去英國旅行時參觀了一座都鐸時期的城堡。

ex.en: The Tudors ruled England for more than a hundred years.
ex.zh: 都鐸王朝統治英格蘭超過一百年。

ex.en: Our history class is studying the Tudors this week.
ex.zh: 我們的歷史課這週在學都鐸王朝。

ex.en: I watched a video tutorial to learn how to bake bread.
ex.zh: 我看了一支教學影片來學怎麼烤麵包。

ex.en: The game starts with a short tutorial that explains the basic controls.
ex.zh: 這款遊戲一開始有個簡短的教學，說明基本操作。

ex.en: Every Thursday she has a tutorial with her professor to discuss her essay.
ex.zh: 每週四她都會和教授上一堂小班指導課，討論她的論文。

ex.en: The students found the weekly tutorial more helpful than the big lecture.
ex.zh: 學生覺得每週的小班指導課比大堂課更有幫助。

ex.en: Mom, my tummy hurts after eating all that candy.
ex.zh: 媽，我吃了那麼多糖，肚子好痛。

ex.en: The baby giggled when I tickled her tummy.
ex.zh: 我搔寶寶的小肚子時，她咯咯笑了起來。

ex.en: She earns extra money by tutoring after school.
ex.zh: 她靠放學後當家教賺外快。

ex.en: Free tutoring is offered to students who fall behind.
ex.zh: 成績落後的學生可以獲得免費的課業輔導。

tutoring.zh: 當家教（tutor 的現在分詞）

ex.en: He is tutoring two students in math this semester.
ex.zh: 他這學期正在輔導兩位學生數學。

ex.en: I'm tutoring my cousin in English every Friday.
ex.zh: 我每週五都在輔導表弟英文。

ex.en: She wore a long blue tunic over her leggings.
ex.zh: 她在緊身褲外面穿了一件藍色長版上衣。

ex.en: Soldiers in ancient Rome wore a simple tunic.
ex.zh: 古羅馬的士兵穿著簡單的束腰外衣。

ex.en: He rented a tuxedo for his cousin's wedding.
ex.zh: 他為表哥的婚禮租了一套無尾禮服。

ex.en: Everyone at the gala was dressed in a tuxedo or a long gown.
ex.zh: 晚宴上每個人不是穿無尾禮服就是穿長禮服。

ex.en: The plumber replaced the old tubing under the sink.
ex.zh: 水電工換掉了水槽下方的舊管子。

ex.en: Clear plastic tubing connects the pump to the fish tank.
ex.zh: 透明塑膠管把幫浦和魚缸連接起來。

ex.en: The garden was full of red and yellow tulips in spring.
ex.zh: 春天時花園裡開滿了紅色和黃色的鬱金香。

ex.en: Holland is famous around the world for its tulip fields.
ex.zh: 荷蘭以鬱金香花田聞名全世界。

ex.en: She put a single tulip in a glass vase on the table.
ex.zh: 她把一朵鬱金香插在桌上的玻璃花瓶裡。

ex.en: Few trees can grow on the frozen tundra.
ex.zh: 很少有樹木能在冰凍的苔原上生長。

ex.en: Reindeer wander across the Arctic tundra.
ex.zh: 馴鹿在北極苔原上漫遊。

ex.en: The singer received a tumultuous welcome from the fans.
ex.zh: 歌手受到粉絲熱烈喧騰的歡迎。

ex.en: It was a tumultuous year for the company, with many changes.
ex.zh: 對公司來說，那是動盪的一年，變動很多。

ex.en: The chair has a light tubular frame made of steel.
ex.zh: 這張椅子有輕巧的鋼製管狀骨架。

ex.en: Some flowers have long tubular petals that hummingbirds love.
ex.zh: 有些花有細長的管狀花瓣，蜂鳥很喜歡。

turbo.zh: 渦輪增壓器；渦輪增壓引擎

ex.en: The car has a turbo, so it accelerates very fast.
ex.zh: 這輛車有渦輪增壓，所以加速很快。

ex.en: My uncle bought a small turbo engine for his truck.
ex.zh: 我叔叔為他的卡車買了一具小型渦輪增壓引擎。

ex.en: She wore a necklace made of turquoise.
ex.zh: 她戴著一條綠松石項鍊。

ex.en: The sea was a clear shade of turquoise.
ex.zh: 海水呈現清澈的青綠色。

ex.en: A small turret rose above the castle wall.
ex.zh: 一座小塔樓矗立在城堡牆上方。

ex.en: The tank's turret can turn in any direction.
ex.zh: 坦克的砲塔可以轉向任何方向。

ex.en: The man wore a bright blue turban at the wedding.
ex.zh: 那名男子在婚禮上戴了一條亮藍色的頭巾。

ex.en: She wrapped a scarf into a turban to keep her hair dry.
ex.zh: 她把圍巾纏成頭巾，讓頭髮保持乾燥。

ex.en: A tuft of grass grew through the crack in the road.
ex.zh: 一簇草從路面的裂縫中長了出來。

ex.en: The baby had a small tuft of dark hair.
ex.zh: 那個嬰兒有一小撮黑色的頭髮。

ex.en: She added a turnip to the vegetable soup.
ex.zh: 她在蔬菜湯裡加了一顆蕪菁。

ex.en: A turnip tastes a bit like a mild radish.
ex.zh: 蕪菁吃起來有點像味道溫和的蘿蔔。

ex.en: Tunisia is a country in North Africa on the Mediterranean coast.
ex.zh: 突尼西亞是北非一個面向地中海的國家。

ex.en: Tunis is the capital city of Tunisia.
ex.zh: 突尼斯是突尼西亞的首都。

ex.en: Tuscany is a region in central Italy.
ex.zh: 托斯卡尼是義大利中部的一個地區。

ex.en: Florence is the main city of Tuscany.
ex.zh: 佛羅倫斯是托斯卡尼的主要城市。

ex.en: She filled the tumbler with cold water.
ex.zh: 她把平底玻璃杯倒滿冰水。

ex.en: There was a tumbler of orange juice on the table.
ex.zh: 桌上有一杯柳橙汁。

ex.en: The tumbler flipped twice in the air to loud applause.
ex.zh: 雜技演員在空中翻了兩圈，贏得熱烈掌聲。

ex.en: A young tumbler performed in the street show.
ex.zh: 一位年輕的雜技演員在街頭表演中登場。

ex.en: He wore a black turtleneck under his jacket.
ex.zh: 他在外套裡面穿了一件黑色高領衫。

ex.en: A turtleneck keeps your neck warm in winter.
ex.zh: 高領衫能在冬天讓脖子保暖。

ex.en: The piano needs tuning before the concert.
ex.zh: 這架鋼琴在音樂會前需要調音。

ex.en: Fine tuning the engine made the car run smoother.
ex.zh: 對引擎做細部調整後，車子跑得更順了。

ex.en: Turin is a city in northern Italy.
ex.zh: 杜林是義大利北部的城市。

ex.en: We took a train from Milan to Turin.
ex.zh: 我們從米蘭搭火車到杜林。

ex.en: The elephant used its tusk to push the fallen branch.
ex.zh: 大象用牠的長牙推開倒下的樹枝。

ex.en: A walrus has two long tusks.
ex.zh: 海象有兩根長長的獠牙。

ex.en: A great tumult rose from the crowd when the singer appeared.
ex.zh: 歌手一出現，群眾中就響起一陣喧鬧。

ex.en: The news threw the whole office into tumult.
ex.zh: 這個消息讓整間辦公室陷入一片騷動。

ex.en: Her mind was in tumult before the big exam.
ex.zh: 大考前她的心裡一團混亂。

ex.en: A potato is a tuber that grows underground.
ex.zh: 馬鈴薯是長在地底下的塊莖。

ex.en: The gardener dug up the tubers before the first frost.
ex.zh: 園丁在第一次霜降前把塊莖挖了出來。

ex.en: Yams and cassava are tubers eaten in many countries.
ex.zh: 山藥和木薯是許多國家食用的塊莖。

tumbling.zh: 翻滾；跌落（tumble 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The boxes kept tumbling off the shelf.
ex.zh: 那些箱子不斷從架子上掉下來。

ex.en: Children were tumbling down the grassy hill, laughing.
ex.zh: 孩子們笑著從草坡上滾下來。

ex.en: Tumbling is one of the events in the gymnastics show.
ex.zh: 翻滾是體操表演的項目之一。

ex.en: She took tumbling lessons to improve her balance.
ex.zh: 她上翻滾課來增進平衡感。

ex.en: He placed the old record on the turntable and lowered the needle.
ex.zh: 他把舊唱片放到唱盤上，放下唱針。

ex.en: The train engine was turned around on a large turntable.
ex.zh: 火車頭在一個大型轉盤上被轉了方向。

ex.en: Tung oil comes from the seeds of the tung tree.
ex.zh: 桐油取自油桐樹的種子。

ex.en: Craftsmen use tung oil to protect wooden furniture.
ex.zh: 工匠用桐油來保護木製家具。

ex.en: She became a fine pianist under his tutelage.
ex.zh: 在他的指導下，她成了出色的鋼琴家。

ex.en: The young artist studied under the tutelage of a famous painter.
ex.zh: 這位年輕藝術家在一位名畫家的指導下學習。

ex.en: The painter used turpentine to clean her brushes.
ex.zh: 畫家用松節油清洗她的畫筆。

ex.en: The room smelled strongly of turpentine.
ex.zh: 房間裡有濃濃的松節油味。

ex.en: He rented a tux for the wedding.
ex.zh: 他為了婚禮租了一套晚禮服。

ex.en: The groom looked sharp in his black tux.
ex.zh: 新郎穿著黑色晚禮服看起來很帥氣。

ex.en: The two boys got into a tussle over the ball.
ex.zh: 兩個男孩為了球扭打起來。

ex.en: There was a long tussle between the two parties over the budget.
ex.zh: 兩黨為了預算爭執了很久。

ex.en: The puppies tussled on the grass all afternoon.
ex.zh: 小狗整個下午都在草地上互相打鬧。

ex.en: The kids tussled over the last slice of pizza.
ex.zh: 孩子們為了最後一片披薩吵成一團。

ex.en: We rented a small Tuscan farmhouse for the summer.
ex.zh: 我們租了一棟托斯卡納的小農舍過夏天。

ex.en: The Tuscan hills are famous for their vineyards.
ex.zh: 托斯卡納的丘陵以葡萄園聞名。

ex.en: We took the turnpike and paid a toll at every exit.
ex.zh: 我們走收費公路，每個出口都要付過路費。

ex.en: Traffic on the turnpike was slow because of the holiday.
ex.zh: 因為假期，收費公路上的車流很慢。

ex.en: The piano tuner came to our house on Tuesday.
ex.zh: 鋼琴調音師星期二來了我們家。

ex.en: A good tuner can hear tiny differences in pitch.
ex.zh: 好的調音師能聽出音高的細微差異。

ex.en: Turn the tuner slowly until the radio station comes in clearly.
ex.zh: 慢慢轉動選台器，直到電台訊號清楚為止。

ex.en: The old stereo had a built-in FM tuner.
ex.zh: 那台舊音響內建了調頻調諧器。

ex.en: He plays the tuba in the school band.
ex.zh: 他在學校樂隊裡吹大號。

ex.en: The deep sound of the tuba filled the hall.
ex.zh: 大號低沉的聲音充滿了整個大廳。

ex.en: Take the next turnoff to reach the beach.
ex.zh: 在下一個出口下去就能到海邊。

ex.en: We missed the turnoff and had to drive back.
ex.zh: 我們錯過了岔路，只好開回頭。

ex.en: The author's turgid style made the book hard to read.
ex.zh: 作者浮誇冗長的文風使這本書很難讀。

ex.en: I fell asleep during his turgid speech.
ex.zh: 我在他冗長浮誇的演講中睡著了。

ex.en: Please turn on the light; it's too dark in here.
ex.zh: 請把燈打開，這裡太暗了。

ex.en: He turned on the TV to watch the news.
ex.zh: 他打開電視看新聞。

ex.en: The dog suddenly turned on its owner and barked loudly.
ex.zh: 那隻狗突然對主人翻臉狂吠。

ex.en: Some of his old friends turned on him when the scandal broke.
ex.zh: 醜聞爆發時，他的一些老朋友突然翻臉攻擊他。

ex.en: Remember to turn off the lights when you leave the room.
ex.zh: 離開房間時記得關燈。

ex.en: She turned off her phone during the movie.
ex.zh: 電影放映時她把手機關掉了。

ex.en: His rude jokes really turned off the audience.
ex.zh: 他粗魯的笑話讓觀眾很反感。

ex.en: Long, boring ads can turn off many viewers.
ex.zh: 冗長無聊的廣告會讓許多觀眾倒胃口。

ex.en: Turn off the highway at the next exit.
ex.zh: 在下一個出口駛離高速公路。

ex.en: We turned off the main road and followed a narrow path.
ex.zh: 我們駛離主要道路，沿著一條小徑前進。

ex.en: She turned down the job because the salary was too low.
ex.zh: 因為薪水太低，她回絕了那份工作。

ex.en: He turned down my invitation to the party.
ex.zh: 他婉拒了我的派對邀請。

ex.en: Could you turn down the music a little?
ex.zh: 你可以把音樂調小聲一點嗎？

ex.en: Please turn down the heat; it's too hot in here.
ex.zh: 請把暖氣調小一點，這裡太熱了。
